_comment: Allternit shared Slack app. Create at https://api.slack.com/apps -> 'Create New App' -> 'From a manifest', paste this file. Then copy Client ID + Client Secret (Basic Information) and Signing Secret into cloud-api env: ALLTERNIT_SLACK_CLIENT_ID, ALLTERNIT_SLACK_CLIENT_SECRET, ALLTERNIT_SLACK_SIGNING_SECRET (old SLACK_* names still work). Manifest reference: https://docs.slack.dev/reference/app-manifest/. Events, commands and the OAuth redirect all point at api.allternit.com (allternit-cloud-api routes::slack_app). Interactivity is off: the cloud has no block-action handler yet.
